subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: The passage deals with the childhood events of the victorian poet Robert Browning. His parents passed on a love of art and literature to him from his early age. Robert was a bright child and attended day school as an infant. After primary school, he was trained in riding, fencing, boxing, singing, and dancing at home. Moreover, he spend much time in reading. Though he entered the University of London, he dropped out after just half a year.
